value.rationale: Lossless representation of the underlying accessibility relation is a central structural issue for newly proposed four-operator intuitionistic semantics. The exact if-and-only-if order-theoretic criterion, universal explicit edge decoder, complete failure obstructions and minimal four-operator design answer a natural semantic question beyond finite chain enumerations. The result also separates operator-level observational information from frame-validity expressivity, so its exact boundary matters for modal reconstruction and model identification.
